profile.headline: Software Engineer 4 at Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries
profile.geoLocationName: Norfolk City County, Virginia, United States
profile.summary:
•	10 + years direct experience in a project management capacity, including concurrently managing multiple projects utilizing Waterfall and Agile SCRUM software development lifecycles over varying period of performance durations.  
•	10 + years of in-depth experience with broad range of team activities including hiring, training, and travel coordination both in and outside the United States.
•	18 + years of experience coordinating/managing DoD web based projects.  
•	18 + years of experience working with projects operating at a Software Engineering Institute (SEI) Capability Maturity Model Integrated (CMMI) Level 3 and 5.

•	DOD TS/SCI held since 2003 and renewed 23 September 2013.  Read off of SCIs 23 August 2016.
•	Project Management Professional (PMP # 1449364) Credential valid through 22 August 2023.

company.name: Newport News Shipbuilding, A Division of Huntington Ingalls Industries

positions.title: Software Engineer 4
positions.description:
•	Serve as the project lead for CVN78/79 PPMC and CVN 77 EPCN.
•	Act as the primary customer contact for program activities, leading program review sessions with customer to discuss business objectives, project cost, schedule, and technical performance.
•	Identify, analyze and mitigate project risks to ensure the schedule avoids unknown obstacles.
•	Ensure formal customer commitments are met according to schedule/budget and collaborate with other project/program managers & department leadership to manage project interdependencies.
•	Identify deficiencies in procedures and work practices by updating and/or creating procedures, templates and checklists as required. 
•	Analyze project metrics and take corrective actions as necessary to ensure problems are addressed and performance improves.

positions.title: IT Program Manager
positions.description:
Note: Laid off from Insignia Technology Services on 10 February 2017 due to lower than expected contract awards.  First gap of employment in over 27 years. 

•	Responsible for full contract life cycle support, from bidding, through engagement initiation, monitoring/execution and closeout. 
•	Work with clients, subcontractors and workforce to respond, execute and delivery high quality services and solutions. 
•	Responsible for managing multiple projects and project manager’s/task leads, responsible for task execution, building high performing teams.
•	Responsible for creating, enforcing processes, standards and methodologies. 
•	Responsible for mentoring and coaching teams.
•	Responsible for overall project execution, client/vendor expectation management and relations.
•	Facility Security Officer (FSO) and Internal Threat Program Senior Official (ITPSO) for the company.

positions.title: Program Manager/Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Responsible for responding to Request for Proposals(RFPs) including developing Basis of Estimate (BOE); and breaking down work into a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and/or Resource Loaded Network (RLN).
•	Responsible for customer service and quality of product released to a worldwide DoD application requiring 24/7 up time.  
•	Direct and coordinate the activities of project’s functional areas including Quality Assurance, Software Engineering, Requirements Management and Database Administration. 
•	Hiring Manager responsibilities which include reviewing resumes, scheduling and conducting interviews, and making job offers.
•	Responsible for updating procedures to reflect work practices, identifying and managing project risks, and generating project status reports.
•	Delegate tasks and provide oversight throughout the entire software development lifecycle; lifecycles include both Waterfall and Agile SCRUM. 
•	Responsible for employee time cards, assessing performance, providing feedback, periodic reviews, employee recognition and counseling. 
•	Extensive experience working with Deltek and PeopleSoft.
•	Responsible for keeping project operating at a SEI CMMI Level 3.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Senior Web Programmer of a technical team in support of UNICORN, Application User Management (AUM) and the Management Information Systems Tool (MIST) Project. 
•	Primary responsibilities included the creation and maintenance of web pages using ColdFusion, ASP, VBScript, JavaScript, AJAX, HTML, and CSS with SQL Server databases.

positions.title: Software Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	Design and develop dynamic web applications in a SQL Server environment for the Air Force using ASP, VBScript, JavaScript and ActiveX Data Objects (ADO).  
•	Modify database design and manipulate data to support user requirements.  Manage and maintain three separate websites including ensuring reliable backups of live data.  
•	Actively participate in clarifying and defining software requirements from end users.  
•	Active participant of Software Development team awarded Carnegie Mellon University’s SEI CMMI Level 5 rating.  
•	Performed unit/system/integration testing of software under development.  Responsible for software version control using SourceSafe.  
•	Key player on teams that analyze, develop, tailor and implement various software standards and procedures for the Level 5 rating. 
•	Collected and distributed metrics  for management.

positions.title: Operations Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed multiple MS Access databases.  Integrated data from various sources, ensuring down time is minimized and data is kept at a high quality.  
•	Involved with various mainframe SAS software applications.  
•	Coordinated overall processing of growth work (emergent work outside original contract) for the USS Nimitz to ensure accuracy of data, completion of work, and speedy receipt of funding. 
•	 Point of contact for various departments to include: Contracts, Cost Engineering, Production Control, and Finance.  Worked with Government Contracting officials and Navy personnel on a daily basis to ensure satisfactory project completion.

positions.title: Waste Control Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Developed and implemented a tracking system using MS Access and MS Excel to track actual and projected radioactive liquids during delivery, treatment and reuse.  
•	Ensured paperwork and shipment of radioactive waste was accomplished in accordance with United States Navy regulations.
